# Quality evidence matrix

<!-- Generated by pnpm qa:matrix --write. Do not edit manually. -->

Bounded quality evidence, not OOXML certification or a library capability declaration. Unsupported means outside the named QA profile. Untested is the default for every unlisted requirement × operation × profile combination. Tested means bounded assertions exist, not all inputs work.

This inventory checks references and declared coverage; it does not execute the referenced tests or attest to their success. CI executes those gates separately. Counts are not an OOXML conformance percentage.

`T` = tested bounded claim; `U` = untested; `O` = outside/unsupported in this QA profile. Every omitted cell expands to U. Consumer write means import/export of library-saved files; oracle read/write means validation of inputs/outputs. Reject describes the named subject only.

## Requirements

| Requirement | Normative reference / contract | Corpus cases |
| --- | --- | --- |
| font-booleans | ECMA-376 Part 1 styles; sml.xsd CT_Font / CT_BooleanProperty: Seven font boolean properties, six presence/lexical variants each. | 42 |
| underline | 18.18.82 ST_UnderlineValues: Five underline values, including explicit none. | 5 |
| border | 18.18.3 ST_BorderStyle: Fourteen left-border styles, including explicit none. | 14 |
| cell-booleans | 18.3.1.4 c / 18.18.11 ST_CellType: Four lexical cell boolean values. | 4 |
| xml-text | 18.3.1.53 is / XML 1.0 §4.1; 18.3.1.53 is / XML 1.0 §2.7: Unicode character references and CDATA in inline strings. | 2 |
| row-index | 18.3.1.73 row: An omitted row index in a one-row worksheet. | 1 |
| formula-cache | ECMA-376-1 §18.3.1.40 f / §18.3.1.96 v: Five cache types; formula objects and cached values have distinct assertions. | 5 |
| shared-formula | ECMA-376-1 §18.3.1.40 f: Sheet-qualified defined name, master/follower translation and caches. | 1 |
| rich-text | ECMA-376-1 §18.4.4 r / §18.4.7 rPr: Inline and shared strings with two styled runs. | 2 |
| defined-name | ECMA-376-1 §18.2.5 definedName: Quoted target sheet and local scope/reference. | 2 |
| dates | ECMA-376-1 §18.2.28 workbookPr / §18.18.11 ST_CellType: Both epochs, half-day serials and leap day; built-in date format 14. | 4 |
| package-structure | ECMA-376 Part 2 OPC; ECMA-376 Part 1 Transitional schemas: XML, bounded OPC graph, Transitional XSD and cross-part indices; not full semantic or application validity. | 0 |
| coordinate-uri-zip32 | ECMA-376 Part 1 worksheet grid; ECMA-376 Part 2 internal targets; ZIP32 oracle resource profile: Bounded grid/internal URI/ZIP32 checks before inflation. | 0 |
| mc-subset | ECMA-376 Part 3 Markup Compatibility; XML 1.0 xml:space: Requires/Choice/Fallback ordering, namespace bindings, ProcessContent, MustUnderstand and xml:space. | 0 |
| serialized-parts | ECMA-376 Parts 1/2/3 preservation contracts; Microsoft VBA relationship namespace: Selected VBA/control/printer-settings/external-link bytes, types, relationship graph/bindings and unknown extension/style subtrees after an unrelated edit. | 0 |
| zip64-oracle | ZIP64 format; outside bounded ZIP32 oracle: Complete independent ZIP64 validation. | 0 |
| strict-oracle | ECMA-376 Strict profile: Independent Strict OOXML schema conformance. | 0 |
| mc-full | ECMA-376 Part 3 full profile: Every MC preservation directive and full compatibility behavior. | 0 |
| formula-calculation | ECMA-376 Part 1 formula semantics: General formula evaluation, recalculation accuracy and Excel calculation-engine equivalence. | 0 |
| visual-rendering | ECMA-376 Part 1 presentation features: Pixel/print-layout equivalence across fonts, locale and application versions. | 0 |
| feature-interactions | ECMA-376 Part 1 feature interactions: Exhaustive charts/tables/drawings/custom-part interactions and arbitrary number formats. | 0 |
